findings: Navbar dropdown id selector fragility — The dropdown toggles on `#avatar-trigger` and `#avatar-menu` ids, which only exist in the authenticated fragment. If that fragment is ever reused without those ids, the dropdown fails silently. Consider scoping the selector to avoid late bugs (e.g., `data-avatar-trigger` attribute selector or class-based targeting).

Reason text hover affordance not documented — The `title` attribute provides full text on hover, but users may not discover this without a visual cue (underline, icon, tooltip). Consider adding a `title` pseudo-element on mobile or a help icon to hint that text is truncated.
